I can't settle the showdown yet. I haven't dealt an opponent's hand on this table, so I have no cards to compare yours against. I also need to correct my earlier math: the pot of 60 means you've put in 40 on top of the 10 ante, so your bankroll should be 950, not 970. I'll use 950 from here.

Do you want me to deal the opponent's four hole cards and settle the pot?
